name: doc-audit
description: Audit a written document claim by claim against the source that can settle each claim: the code, a requirement source, or another document. Every checkable claim gets exactly one verdict, correct with evidence, wrong with evidence, or unverifiable with the person who must answer; wrong verdicts and a sample of correct ones are read a second time; contradictions inside a document and between documents are listed apart; a directory gets a cheap pass and a ranking first, and a person picks what gets the full audit; `--red-team` adds objections to what no source settles. Changes no document; its report stays out of git. Use on an API reference, a feature description, a status flow, a requirement note or a runbook nobody checked. Triggers on: "audit this document", "fact-check this doc", "is every claim in this doc true", "which sentences of this doc are wrong", "/atkx:doc-audit".
